quests.title: Whispers at the Three Broomsticks
quests.description: Professor Longbottom pulls you aside at the Three Broomsticks. Strange magical disturbances have been reported near Hogwarts — plants in the greenhouses dying overnight, wards flickering. Someone or something is probing the castle's defenses.

quests.title: The New Chamber
quests.description: McGonagall reveals that a second chamber has been discovered beneath the Room of Requirement. Ancient runes seal it shut. Someone is trying to open it from the outside — using dark magic that predates even Salazar Slytherin.

objectives.text: Prevent the chamber from being opened

quests.title: The Hollow Prophecy
quests.description: An anonymous owl leads you to Unspeakable Vane in the Department of Mysteries. A new prophecy has formed — and it involves you. The Hollow Mage already knows your name. You must retrieve the prophecy before his agents do.

quests.title: Azkaban's Secret
quests.description: Prisoners are vanishing from Azkaban. Minister Shacklebolt needs someone off the official record to investigate. The Hollow Mage is at the center of this — and he wants to be found.

quests.title: Fragments of a Dead Soul
quests.description: The Hollow Mage's plan is revealed: use the Horcrux fragments scattered across Britain to anchor a new dark entity — a soul-construct of pure malice. You must destroy every fragment before the ritual is complete.

objectives.text: Acquire Fiendfyre or Basilisk Venom for destruction
Confront and defeat the Hollow Mage

quests.title: Butterbeer and Bad Omens
quests.description: Rosmerta has been serving a mysterious cloaked figure every Thursday night. Last Thursday, the figure left behind a small package — which is now hissing.

quests.title: The Stars Don't Lie
quests.description: Firenze sends a message via the forest birds: the stars show a great darkness converging on Hogwarts within a lunar cycle. He will share what he knows — if you come to him in the Forbidden Forest and prove you understand that some things are worth more than safety.

objectives.text: Enter the Forbidden Forest at night

quests.title: Honeydukes Heist
quests.description: Someone has been stealing from Honeydukes — but only specific items: every batch of Crystallized Pineapple, every Acid Pop, every Pepper Imp. The thief has been getting in and out without breaking the wards.

objectives.text: Investigate the back entrance of Honeydukes
Identify the thief's method of entry
Confront the thief or report your findings

quests.title: The Whomping Willow's Sorrow
quests.description: The Whomping Willow has stopped attacking. For two weeks. Neville is convinced it's not relief — it's grief. Something happened to it, and it would tell you if it could.

objectives.text: Examine the Whomping Willow without being struck
Find what changed in the tree's environment

quests.title: Letters from a Dead Auror
quests.description: An owl delivers a letter to Minister Shacklebolt — postmarked four years ago, in the handwriting of an Auror who died during the Second Wizarding War. The contents describe an operation that didn't happen until last month. Either time is broken, or someone has been planning very far ahead.

objectives.text: Authenticate the letter's handwriting and ink

quests.title: The Quibbler Anomaly
quests.description: Every copy of last week's Quibbler has shifted, in print, overnight. The articles are now about events that haven't happened yet — but they're starting to. Luna Lovegood wants someone to help her figure out who's editing reality.

objectives.text: Read all current Quibbler articles carefully
Verify which prophecies have already come true
Find the source of the rewriting

quests.title: Borgin's Bargain
quests.description: Borgin offers you a private deal: retrieve a sealed box from a hidden cellar beneath Knockturn Alley. He won't say what's inside. Refuse, and he won't say what happens next either. The Galleons offered are excessive — which is the warning sign.

objectives.text: Retrieve the sealed box without opening it
Decide whether to deliver, destroy, or report it

quests.title: The Phoenix's Last Tear
quests.description: Fawkes — Dumbledore's phoenix — has been seen again at Hogwarts, though it should have been impossible. McGonagall believes Fawkes returned for a reason. The phoenix appears only at midnight, in the same corridor, and weeps once before disappearing.

objectives.text: Be in the corridor at midnight
Collect the phoenix tear before it evaporates
Determine what the tear is meant to heal

quests.title: The Mirror in the Cellar
quests.description: Rosmerta tells you that the cellar of the Three Broomsticks now contains a tall standing mirror that wasn't there last week — and the mirror shows everyone *as someone else*. She'd like it removed before any customers find it.

objectives.text: Discover who placed it there and why
Remove or destroy the mirror safely

quests.title: The Last Marauder
quests.description: A scrap of parchment in the Hogwarts library, when examined under moonlight, reveals the original Marauder's Map — but a section labeled 'Chamber of Echoes' has been added in a fifth handwriting. Neither Lupin nor any of the original Marauders wrote it. Someone has been adding to the map.

objectives.text: Decode the new section of the map

quests.title: The Hourglass That Wasn't
quests.description: An hourglass in McGonagall's office has been counting down for three weeks. Nobody knows when it was started. Nobody knows what happens when it reaches zero. It has about six hours left.

objectives.text: Examine the hourglass without touching it
Stop the countdown before it completes — or let it finish

quests.title: Dementor's Apprentice
quests.description: A young Auror trainee has begun manifesting Dementor-like behavior in their sleep — radiating cold, fogging mirrors, leaving the temperature in a room ten degrees colder when they leave. They don't remember it. The Ministry needs to know if this is possession, infection, or something new.

objectives.text: Interview the trainee while they're awake
Observe them during a sleep cycle safely
